pages.text: The Life Activator burns life energy to neutralize exhausted fuel (100 life energy per mb), 1:1 into activated exhausted liquid.$(br)Waste pipes feed the input tank; normal liquid pipes pull from the output tank — waste in, safe liquid out.

The Life Centrifuge splits activated fuel into a main product and a byproduct.$(br)The Activated Fractionator then refines the activated components — these get polymerized into plasma on the road to fusion. Waste isn't the end, it's the start.
The Item Reconstructor rebuilds items from exhausted crystals, turning waste back into usable resources.$(br)Trash in, treasure out — truly "turning trash into treasure".

Exhausted waste pipes come in two flavors:$(li)Sealed Exhausted Pipe: single buffer, steady as a rock$(li)Multi-Fluid Waste Pipe: multi-buffer, bulk and then some$(br)They haul waste and nothing else — the dedicated waste courier feeding your Activator's input.
